I don't hate events like
this, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0e 00}I{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}remember the flowers

give people flowers unless
you really mean it.

{07 0e 00}Ma{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}mäletan lilli,

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Just once, I'd like to walk

flowers bigger than me!
